hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for Hookr-graduated pools with configurable anti-snipe guard (block-gated buy caps and extra LP fees), dynamic surge fees scaled by trade size, auto-burn of token output to 0xdEaD, LP reward donations inside the swap, and a deterministic per-pool jackpot on qualifying buys (no randomness claimed).
